title: Little Creators Quiz
description: Let's see what you remember about creating art and exploring God's world!

questions.question: Who is the greatest Creator of all?
questions.explanation: God is the greatest Creator! He made the heavens and the earth and everything in them (Genesis 1:1).

questions.question: What can you find outside to make a nature collage?
questions.explanation: We can find leaves, sticks, flowers, and pebbles outside — all beautiful things God made for us to enjoy!

questions.question: What new color do you get when you mix red and yellow?
questions.explanation: When you mix red and yellow together, you get orange! God filled His world with wonderful colors.

questions.question: Who made all the animals?
questions.explanation: God made all the animals — big ones, tiny ones, and every kind in between (Genesis 1:25)!

questions.question: What does God put in the sky after it rains?
questions.explanation: God put the rainbow in the sky as His special promise. It has many beautiful colors (Genesis 9:13)!

questions.question: How many senses did God give us?
questions.explanation: God gave us five wonderful senses — sight, hearing, smell, taste, and touch — so we can enjoy His creation (Psalm 139:14)!
